title: primula veris subsp. columnae
intro: Primula veris subsp. columnae, commonly known as Columned Cowslip, is a subspecies of the primrose plant native to the mountainous regions of Eastern Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues such as coughs and colds due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it useful for soothing sore throats, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Primula veris subsp. columnae include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
